verdict.rationale: Brex offers a broad developer API and an official MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair axis, but nothing in the pack documents API token scopes, permission levels, or least-privilege credential issuance for agents. Spend limits on vendor-specific cards and budgets are financial controls, not API credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
